turns.content: Oli otya mukwano gwange ogw'omunda? Omutima gunkubye nnyo leero!
Gyendi bulungi munnange! Kiki ekyo ekikukubizza omutima bwe kityo? Waliwo omuntu akuteesezza akaseko?
Omulenzi gwe mbadde nkwana emyezi esatu ampadde akapapula ng'ampita ku caayi akawungeezi kano!
Aluluuu! Eby'omukwano biba biwooma nga bikutandiseeko mpolampola. Genda omusekereeko naye togwiramu nnyo amangu!
Wasuze otya nno mukozi waffe ow'ettendo? Mwannyinaze ankozeeko ekintu ekisesa!
Wasuze bulungi mukwano! Kiki ekyo kye yakukozeeko ekyakusekezza enkya eno?
Ayambadde essaati yange empya ng'alowooza nti siriikawo, ng'azzeeyo ku mulimu ne mugwako mu maaso!
Hahaha! Ab'oluganda banyaga engoye ng'abazibye amaso! Musalireko amagezi naye eby'engoye mu famire tebiggwaayo.
Osiibye otya nnyabo? Mbadde nkurowoozaako leero!
Nsiibye bulungi nnyo ssebo! Okundowoozaako kuleeta essanyu ku mutima. Kiki ekiri ku mulyango gw'amaka go?
Mulirwana wange anzisezza ennyonta, andesezza ettooke eryengedde n'akatunguluulu.
Omulirwana omulungi asinga n'ow'oluganda ali ewala! Omulirwana ng'oyo musanyukire era naawe olulala omugabireko.
Banange, otyanno ku makya gano ag'omukwano?
Bulungi nnyo mukwano gwange! Enkya eno ejjudde obuteefu. Ggwe ozuukidde mu ndowooza ki?
Nzuukidde ne birowoozo by'omukazi gwe njagala okuwasa, nneebuuza oba bazadde be bananzikiriza.
Toggwamu maanyi! Bw'oba olina empisa n'omukwano ogw'amazima, abazadde b'omuwala bajja kukusiima mangu nnyo.
Nkulamusizza n'essanyu eringi akawungeezi kano! Taata wange ankoledde ekintu ekikulu.
Nzikirizza mukwano! Kiki ekyo taata wo ky'akoze ekikutumbudde emmeeme?
Ampadde akabanja k'ebitooke e Mukono nzimbeeko akayumba kange akasooka!
Kulika omukisa ogwo ogw'omuzadde! Ettaka lye bugagga obutaggwaawo, mutendereze nnyo olw'omutima ogwo omugagga.
Gyebale emirimu nno mukulu w'amaka! Mukwano gwange anzirizza kaadi yange.
Kale nnyo ssebo, nawe gyebale! Omukwano ogudda mu butuufu guleeta emirembe. Abadde yagikukuumira bbanga ki?
Yali agimazeeko omwaka mulamba, nnali ndowooza nti agibuze!
Hahaha! Omukwano ogwo nno guggumidde okukuzzaayo ekintu ky'omwaka omulamba, omuntu ng'oyo tatera kubulwako bwesigwa.
Owange, ekisesa nkikuleetere mangu leero?
Kireete mangu nsekeeko munnange! Obudde buno bwetaaga kaseko akatono.
Mbadde ngezaako okusaba namba y'omukazi gwe njagala, ne nsaba ey'omukozi we ali ku mulyango!
Bambi! Wakute nsawo ya bukyamu ddala! Omukozi we yakwesesezza atya oluvannyuma?
Yansekereredde n'ang'amba nti mukama we y'ali munda!
Hahaha! Obuzira bwo bwa kitalo, naye olulala sooka wekkaanye ani mukama w'amaka nga tonnasaba namba!
Kiki ekiri eyo ku kyalo kyammwe munnange? Eno tusiibye mu ssanyu.
Eno kuli mirembe gyereere mukwano! Essanyu ly'eyo lizinze ki ekikulu?
Baganda bange abasatu bazze okuva mu bibuga byonna ne tusisinkana awaka wa maama!
Okwesunga okw'ekika ekyo kuleeta essanyu eritaliiko kkomo! Maama yalabika yafumbye ebirungi ebitaliiko kkomo olwaleero.
Mirembe gyammwe abalina emikwano emirungi! Nze owange annaze leero.
Mirembe nnyo munnange! Kiki ekyo mukwano gwo kye yakukoze ekikunyiizizza?
Tupanze okugenda okulya enkoko e Kafunda, ate n'ayita mukazi we nga simanyi!
Hahaha! Ayonoonye akazannyo k'abasajja bokka! Naye fuba okumusonyiwa, abasajja abaliko omukwano ebiseera ebimu baba tebeesala.
Kulika olugendo olw'okulambula abazadde mukwano!
Kale nnyo nnyabo! Okulambula abazadde kusumulula emikisa mingi. Obasanze bali batya eyo?
Basanyuse bubi nnyo, ate jjajja ampadde enkoko ey'amagi mukaaga!
Jjajja aba tamanyi kwonoona muzzukulu! Enkoko eyo gigumye ebiseera byonna ojja kugiwerereza amagi mangi.
Osiibye otya nno mukozi waffe ow'omutima omulungi?
Nsiibye bulungi mukwano! Omutima omulungi gwe guziyiza ebizibu. Ggwe osiibye otya mu maka go?
Nsiibye bulungi, mbadde nseka mulirwana eyabadde ayomba n'enkoko ye eyali emuliiridde amakoola g'ennyanya.
Hahaha! Omuntu okuyomba n'enkoko kisesa nnyo, naye ennyanya z'omuntu zikola obulumi bwe ziribwa obwereere!
Banange, otyanno leero ku Lwokusatu luno olw'omukwano?
Bulungi nnyo munnange! Omukwano gwe guziyingira mu wiiki yonna. Ggwe oli mu bya kuganza leero?
Ndi mu bya kuganza ddala, nteesezza okuwandiikira omwagalwa wange akabaluwa ak'edda ak'amapesa.
Ebbaluwa ez'emikono zirina akawoowo k'omukwano akatasalika musango! Mujjiremu amagezi gajja kumutuuka ku mutima butereevu.
Wasuze otya nno omuntu wange ow'akasaale k'ennyama?
Wasuze bulungi ssebo! Akasaale k'ennyama kaleetera abantu okuseka. Enkya yo eri etya?
Ndi bulungi naye mukazi wange anzisezza enjala, annyigidde nti saasiimye dodo gye yafumbye jjo!
Bambi! Abakazi baagala nnyo okusiimibwa ku bufumbi bwabwe. Genda omugambeko kati nti eddoodo eryo lyali lisinga ery'ebweru yonna, ajja kukuwa eky'amakya!
Nkulamusizza n'eddoboozi ery'essanyu enkya eno!
Nzikirizza ssebo! Essanyu lyo linyirizza akawungeezi kano. Kiki ekikutumbudde omutima?
Kojja wange anjagaza omuwala ow'amagezi era eyakula mu mpisa z'obuntu bulamu!
Kojja bwe yeetaba mu nsonga z'omukwano aba akakasa obulungi bw'amaka agagenda okuzimbibwa! Musisinkane n'omutima oguteefu.
Kulika emirimu egy'amaka mukwano!
Kale nnyo nnyabo, nawe kulika nnyo! Amaka gano gali bwe gatyo geetaaga obukozi obutakoma. Ggwe oteredde bulungi?
Nteredde bulungi, mbadde nsekerera mutabani wange eyabadde yeewuunya engeri enkoko gye yeebakiramu ku muti.
Abaana bato balina ebibuuzo ebisesa eby'obutonde! Muyigirize amagezi agakwata ku bisolo n'engeri gye byekuumamu.
Oli otya nno muzzukulu wa Ssekabaka Muteesa?
Gyendi bulungi mukwano! Obulangira tubussaamu ekitiibwa kyonna. Ggwe eka bibadde bitya leero?
Bibadde bulungi, mukwano gwange ampise ku mbaga ya mwannyina ku Lwomukaaga.
Embaga ebaamu emiziki n'emmere ewooma! Tegeka olugoye lwo olunene ogende onyirire mu bagenyi.
Mbadde nneebuuza oba okyajjuukira mukwano gwaffe ow'edda, oli otya?
Ndi bulungi munnange! Emikwano egy'edda tegyerabirwa mangu. Ani oyo gwe wabadde ojjuukira?
Mbadde njukira mukwano gwaffe gwe twalyanga naye ebinyebwa ku ssomero lya pulayimale.
Hahaha! Eby'obuto birimu obumu obw'amazima obwali butaliko busosoze bwa nsimbi! Mukubeeko essimu mulembere wamu.
Osiibye otya nno munnakatemba waffe?
Nsiibye bulungi ssebo! Katemba w'omukwano gwe gutukuuma nga tuli balamu. Ggwe olina kisesa ki eky'olwaleero?
Mulirwana wange asabye omuliro gw'amanda, ate n'asigalawo n'ayokya n'ennyama ye yonna ku kyoto kyange!
Hahaha! Oyo mulirwana yakiriza omugani nti "funa ku mukwano ojjulemu olubuto"! Naye mukuume akaseko mubeere balungi.
Banange, otyanno ku budde buno obw'okusanyuka n'abaana?
Bulungi nnyo munnange! Abaana bawa essanyu eriggulawo ebirowoozo byonna ebyakaddiye. Ggwe obazannyisizza ki leero?
Tubadde tuzannya kakebe n'okwepena mu luggya wano, nkooye naye ndi musanyufu!
Okuzannya n'abaana kuleeta obuto obupya mu mubiri gw'omuntu mukulu! Wummula obulungi kati emmeeme ekkakkane.
Nkulamusizza n'omutima ogukubira omukwano ogw'enkomeredde!
Nzikirizza mukwano gwange! Omukwano ogw'enkomeredde gye mikisa gye tusaba buli lunaku. Ggwe ozuukuse otya?
Nzuukuse bulungi, mbadde neenyumiriza mu ngeri muganda wange gye yannyambye okusasula ebisale by'essomero ly'omwana.
Ab'oluganda abajja mu budde bw'obwetaavu babeera ng'ensawo y'emikisa egabiddwa Katonda! Mwebaze nnyo omutima gwe.
Wasuze otya nno munnange eyalwana n'obufumbo?
Wasuze bulungi ssebo! Obufumbo tebulwanibwa na maanyi ga mikono wabula na magero g'omutima ogukkakkamu. Ggwe oteredde mu maka?
Twateredde nnyo leero, nfunye ebimuli by'amapesa ne mbiwa mukazi wange n'atandika okuseka nga bbaasi!
Hahaha! Ebintu ebitono ng'ebyo bye bizzaamu omukwano amanyi amapya! Okumusekerera n'omutima kusinga buli kintu kyonna.
Ki ekiriwo mu kisaakaate kyammwe nno leero?
Tewali kibadde kibi mukwano! Empewo eweweeza bulungi n'abantu baseka. Ggwe eka eyo banyumya ki?
Ssenga wange azze okulambula, atandise okumbuuza lwaki sirina mwana wadde nga nkyali ku yunivasite!
Bambi ba ssenga tebatera kumanya nti eby'okusoma byetaaga obwongo obw'omu nsiike! Musekereeko mpolampola omugambe nti byonna birina ekiseera kyabyo.
Kulika omugendo gw'okusisinkana abako mukwano!
Kale nnyo nnyabo! Abako bwe babasisinkana bateekwa kusanyukirwa mu buntu bulamu. Byatambudde bitya eyo?
Byatambudde bulungi, ba muko bansiimye nnyo olw'embuzi n'amatooke ge nnabatwalidde.
Ekyo kizzaamu ekitiibwa ky'omulenzi mu maka g'abakazi! Olugero lwo lukwatidde mu bwesigwa obw'enkomeredde.
Oli otya nno omuvubuka amanyi okuganza?
Gyendi bulungi mukwano! Okuganza kwetaaga empisa n'omutima oguteefu. Ggwe oyise otya olunaku olwaleero?
Mbadde nneesunga okutwala mukwano gwange ku mwalo e Ggaba tulye engege enkalu.
E Ggaba ku mwalo nno wateera okubaamu akapewo akaweweeza ennyo omukwano! Mutwale n'essanyu mulye bulungi.
Nkulamusizza n'akaseko akatono ak'omunda!
Nzikirizza n'omutima ogukkakkanye ssebo! Akaseko ako kandeetedde essanyu lingi. Kiki ekinyuma mu budde buno?
Senga wange ampise ku ssimu n'ang'amba nti ajja kumpa akakodyo k'okufumbira bba wange luwombo olutazirikira.
Amagezi ga ba ssenga gaba ga muwendo nnyo mu bufumbo! Gayige n'omutima gwo gwonna ojja kukuuma amaka go nga manywevu.
Osiibye otya nno muzzukulu eyazaalibwa mu ssanyu?
Nsiibye bulungi nnyo mukwano! Essanyu lye litukuuma nga tulina amaanyi. Ggwe osiibye otya mu banne bo?
Nsiibye bulungi, mbadde nseka mulirwana wange eyakutte enkoko n'alowooza nti ya bwereere ate n'asanga nga ya mukazi we!
Hahaha! Ebyo byabise munda mu maka ge! Mukazi we yamusinzizza amagezi mu kaseera ako.
Banange, otyanno ku Lwomukaaga luno olw'amaka?
Bulungi nnyo munnange! Olwomukaaga lutegekeddwa okubeera wamu n'abaana n'ab'enganda. Ggwe okikozeeko ki leero?
Mbadde ntegeka ka kyoto ak'embirigo nga tukuba olugero n'abaana wano mu luggya.
Eby'ekyoto ebyo birina engeri gye bizimbamu empisa z'abaana n'omukwano gw'amaka! Kikuume ekyo kisaana okutwalibwa mu maaso.
Wasuze otya nno munnange eyalonda obulungi?
Wasuze bulungi ssebo! Okulonda obulungi kusumulula emirembe egy'enkomeredde. Ggwe ozuukidde ku birungi?
Nzuukidde ku birungi nnyo, omukazi wange annyokezza ka gonja n'aka caayi akalimu tangawuzi!
Oyo nno mufumbo ddala ow'empisa! Mwebaze omukisa ogwo ogukusangidde mu maka go ag'essanyu.
Akapewo k'amaka kakkakkanye leero, oli otya nno?
Gyendi bulungi mukwano! Obuteefu bw'amaka kye kisa ekisinga obunene. Ggwe obudde bukwatidde wa?
Ndi wano nkoze akatabo k'amannya g'abagenyi b'embaga yaffe ey'omwezi ogujja.
Embaga ebaamu abantu bangi, fuba okulaba ng'obala abantu abakulu n'emmere etegekeddwa bulungi muleme kufuna busungu mu mikolo.
Nkulamusizza n'omukwano omunene ogutaggwaawo!
Nzikirizza ssebo! Omukwano ogutaggwaawo gye miggo egizimba emirembe mu bulamu. Kiki ekiri ku mutima gwo leero?
Mbadde njukira engeri mukwano gwange gwe twakula naye gye yantaasanga ku bamenyi b'amateeka ku ssomero.
Omukwano ogwo guba gwa mukisa munene nnyo! Mukwano gwo oyo mutendereze buli kadde kubanga abakwano ab'amazima tebatendwa bwereere.
Osiibye otya nno omuntu wange eyazaala abalongo?
Nsiibye bulungi mukwano! Abalongo bawa ekitiibwa kinene mu Buganda. Ggwe osiibye otya mu luggya lwo?
Nsiibye bulungi, naye abalongo bano bakooye okuzannya amateeka, kati bali mu kukaaba mazzi!
Bambi abalongo banyiga omutwe bwe baba bakooye! Baweereze amata mangu obasibe mu bibindo beefunyeko batereere.
Banange, otyanno ku makya gano ag'omukisa omugagga?
Bulungi nnyo munnange! Omukisa gutwetoolodde enkya eno. Ggwe ozuukidde ku mulimu ki ogusooka?
Nsoose kuwandiikira mukwano gwange e Masaka musanyukireko olw'okufuna omulimu omupya.
Okusanyukira munno bw'afuna amagoba kye kisa ekisinga obulungi! Omukisa gwo gulyongera okukula olw'omutima ogwo.
Kulika obusungu bw'omukazi wo enkya ya leero!
Kale nnyo mukwano! Obusungu bw'amaka bukkakkanyizibwa na kigambo eky'obuwombeefu. Yakusunguwaddeko ki ekyo?
Nerabidde okumusalira ku ssente z'enviiri ze yamazeeko olunaku olw'eggulo ng'anoonya!
Hahaha! Enviiri z'omukazi ze zimu ku bintu ebisinga okumussa mu ddembe! Ziweereze kati ng'otaddeko n'akatono ak'ennyongeza ajja kuseka mangu.
Wasuze otya nno munnange eyalinda abazadde okukkiriza?
Wasuze bulungi ssebo! Abazadde bwe bakkiriza emikisa gitonnya ng'enkuba. Bakukkirizza ku nsonga ki?
Bakkirizza mukwano gwange okuntwala mu bazadde be ku wiikendi eno!
Aluluuu! Olugendo lwo lukwatidde mu kkubo ddala! Tegeka akatabo n'ebirabo eby'empisa ojja kubanyumira nnyo.
Ki ekigwaayo mu kitundu kyammwe ku nsonga z'omukwano?
Tewali kibadde kibi mukwano, abantu bali mu kwagala n'okuzimba amaka! Eyo gy'oli ekiriwo kiki?
Mbadde nneebuuza oba kiba kirungi okubuulira mukwano gwo byonna ebikukwatako nga temunnaba kuwasa.
Obwesimbu bwe musingi gw'amaka amanywevu! Okumanyira amakulu kiyamba obutazimba bufumbo ku bulimba obuyinza okumenyeka oluvannyuma.
Oli otya nno muzzukulu w'e Mawokota eyalima emmwanyi?
Gyendi bulungi mukwano! Emmwanyi zikyali za muwendo mu kusasula ebisale by'amaka. Ggwe osiibye otya leero?
Nsiibye bulungi, mbadde nsekerera mwannyinaze eyagezezzaako okufumba kawunga ne kamulemerako ne kaba ng'amayinja!
Hahaha! Akawunga bwe kagana okukutuka mu mazzi kalina okumenyeka n'omwiko omugumu! Muyambe amanye engeri y'okusumulula obuwunga mu mazzi amatono nga tannateeka ku muliro.
Nkulamusizza nga ndi mu kusoma ebaluwa y'omukwano!
Nzikirizza ssebo! Ebbaluwa y'omukwano esaanuusa emmeeme. Erimu bibala ki ebiwooma?
Erimu ebigambo eby'omutima ebikakasa nti tewali mulala gwe yeesiga mu nsi yonna okuggyako nze!
Ekyo kirungi nnyo! Kuuma obwesigwa obwo obutayonooneka kubanga obwesige bwe buwangaaza omukwano ogw'amazima.
Osiibye otya nno omuntu wange ow'omwoyo omukkakkamu?
Nsiibye bulungi munnange! Omwoyo omukkakkamu guzaala emirembe mu maka. Ggwe olina kye wategese akawungeezi kano?
Ntegese okulambula ku mukadde waffe ali ku lusozi e Kasangati tumuleetere ku caayi n'amata.
Okulambula abakadde kusumulula emikisa gy'obulamu obulungi! Genda n'essanyu bamanyi nti tebalereddwa bwereere.
Banange, otyanno ku budde buno obw'okusanyuka n'omulenzi?
Bulungi nnyo nnyabo! Essanyu ly'omulenzi w'omutima likkiriza omubiri gwonna okuwummula. Kiki ekyakutuuseeko ekisanyusa?
Ampadde akapira akapya akakwata ku kikuuno kye njagala ne kazaamu essanyu lingi!
Omukwano ogumanyi ky'oyagala guba gwa bbeeyi nnyo! Musekereeko era omwebaze n'omutima omukkakkamu.
Wasuze otya nno taata w'abaana ab'empisa?
Wasuze bulungi mukwano! Abaana ab'empisa kye kitiibwa ky'omuzadde mu kyalo. Ggwe eka bibadde bitya enkya eno?
Bibadde bulungi, abaana bazuukukidde ku kusoma bitabo byabwe n'okwoza ebikopo by'amaka.
Oyo muzadde mulungi eyabakuza obulungi! Okuyiga emirimu gya waka kiyamba abaana okukula nga basobola okwerabirira mu bulamu.
Akapewo k'omukwano kakkakkanye akawungeezi kano, oli otya?
Gyendi bulungi munnange! Empewo eno etutaddeko essanyu eritaliiko kkomo. Ggwe oteredde bulungi ku lulyo?
Nteredde bulungi, mbadde nseka mukwano gwange eyatuuse mu kwanjula n'asanga nga kkanzu ye etobye!
Hahaha! Ekkanzu etobye mu kwanjula ekola ekisesa naye erimu n'obuswaza obutono! Yakikozeeko atya oluvannyuma?
Baafunye akatawulo ke baagikazisa mu bwangu nga tebannayingira mu kisaakaate!
Awo nno baakozesezza amagezi ag'amangu! Abasajja ba Baganda tebabulwamu buvumu mu biseera bwe bityo.
Nkulamusizza n'eddoboozi ery'obwesigwa obw'enkomeredde!
Nzikirizza ssebo! Obwesigwa bwe buteeka emikwano gyonna ku lwazi olunywevu. Kiki ekikuliko leero mukwano?
Mbadde nneebuuza engeri gye tuyinza okugololeramu bannyinaze abayomba buli kadde olw'obutakkaanya ku bintu by'amaka.
Batuuze wamu ng'omutwe omukulu guli mu ddembe, buli omu amanyisibwe obuvunaanyizibwa bwe nga tewali kusosola. Okuteesa mu mazima kuleeta obumu obw'olubeerera.
Osiibye otya nno muzzukulu wa Kintu eyasima omukwano?
Nsiibye bulungi mukwano! Kintu ne Nnambi baatandikawo ennono y'obufumbo obw'amaanyi. Ggwe osiibye otya mu bya kuganza?
Nsiibye bulungi, mukwano gwange andesezza aka kyeeki akatono akawunya vanira!
Akawoowo ka kyeeki kazaamu essanyu lingi! Kalyeerewo n'omutima omukkakkamu, omukwano gwammwe gukule nga bwe guli.
Banange, otyanno ku lunaku luno olw'abanywani ab'edda?
Bulungi nnyo munnange! Abanywani ab'edda balinga ezaabu etakaddiwa. Ggwe osisinkanyeeko omu leero?
Twasisinkanye ne mukwano gwange gwe nnali naye mu kibiina e Makerere, twatudde awo ne tuseka bubi nnyo!
Ebirowoozo by'edda bizuukusa obuto n'emirembe mu mutima! Okuddamu okusisinkana kizzaamu amaanyi amapya mu bulamu.
Wasuze otya nno gwe nfaako buli kadde?
Wasuze bulungi mukwano gwange! Okumanya nti waliwo akufaako kisumulula emmeeme. Enkya yo eri etya?
Eri ya ddembe, mbadde nsekerera bba wange eyabadde agezaako okusiba taayi nga tesobola kumuvaako bulungi!
Hahaha! Taayi eyinza okusobera omusajja bwe kiba nga teyagikolerawo mangu! Muyambe ogikwate ogisibe n'akaseko ako ak'omukwano.
Kulika omulimu ogw'okufumbira abako emmere leero!
Kale nnyo mukwano! Okufumbira abako kuteeka ekitiibwa ky'omuwala kungulu. Emmere yawomye bulungi?
Yawomye nnyo, baalide oluwombo lw'embuzi n'amatooke ne basiima n'okutuusa kati!
Omazeeko ddala! Obufumbi bw'omukazi bwe bumu ku bisumuluzo ebiggula amaka ag'essanyu n'ekitiibwa.
Ki ekinyuma mu luggya lwammwe akawungeezi kano?
Tuli mu ddembe mukwano! Abaana bazannya n'abakulu banyumya ku mikolo gy'ebyalo. Ggwe eka eyo kiki ekiriwo?
Mulirwana wange anzisezza enjala, andesezza ka lumonde ow'okwokya ne supu w'ebijanjaalo.
Abalirwana abalungi bwe batyo be banyweza ebyalo byaffe! Kiriirewo n'omutima omukkakkamu, obulamu bugenda mumaaso.
Oli otya nno mukwano gwe nsinga okwagala mu nsi?
Gyendi bulungi munnange! Ebigambo byo biteesezza akaseko ku matama gange. Kiki ekikutumbudde omukwano bwe gutyo leero?

Nzuukidde ku kusoma bitabo by'amaka n'okusala amagezi n'abazadde baffe abakadde.
Okusala amagezi n'abazadde kuleeta obugagga obw'amagezi agatalagaamu buwonvu! Bategeze byonna n'omutima omukkakkamu.
Wasuze otya nno omuntu wange eyalinda enjuba okuvaayo?
Wasuze bulungi mukwano! Enjuba evaayo n'essanyu eripya buli enkya. Ggwe ozuukidde mu kuteesa ki?
Nzuukidde mu kuteesa n'omwagalwa wange ku ngeri gye tunaazimbyemu akayumba kaffe ak'ebitooke.
Okuzimbira awamu kizzaamu omukwano amaanyi amapya! Ebyo byonna Katonda ajja kubiteeka mu kkubo ddala.
Akapewo k'ettuntu kakkakkanye akawungeezi kano, oli otya yo?
Gyendi bulungi munnange! Empewo eno etulaze nti olunaku lukomekkerezeddwa obulungi. Ggwe oteredde bulungi?
Nteredde bulungi, mbadde nseka mulirwana wange eyakutte embazzi n'atemako omuti ogwali gugwa ku kiyumba ky'embuzi ye!
Yakozesezza amagezi ag'amangu nnyo obutafeebya mbuzi ye! Omuntu ateekwa okuba omwegendereza ku bintu ebyetoolodde amaka ge.
Nkulamusizza n'eddoboozi ery'okusumulula emirembe!
Nzikirizza ssebo! Emirembe gye tusaba buli lunaku. Kiki ekikuliko ekinyuma akawungeezi kano?
Mukwano gwange anzisezza enjala, andesezza ka matooke agookya n'enva z'ebijanjaalo ne nseka n'essanyu!
Amatooke agookya n'ebijanjaalo biba biwooma ate biwanvuya embuto obutakomawo mangu ku njala! Kamaleeko mirembe.
Osiibye otya nno muzzukulu eyalonda obuwangwa obw'omutendo?
Nsiibye bulungi mukwano! Obuwangwa bwe buggyo bwaffe Baganda. Ggwe osiibye otya mu banne bo?
Nsiibye bulungi, mbadde nnyigiriza baana bange engeri y'okukwatamu ebirenge n'okusiba oluwombo lw'ennyama.
Okuyigiriza abaana okusiba oluwombo kikuuma obuwangwa bwaffe obw'obuntu bulamu nga tebubuze! Mulimu gwa kitiibwa kye wakola.
Banange, otyanno ku makya gano ag'okusanyukira awamu n'ab'oluganda?
Bulungi nnyo munnange! Ab'oluganda bwe baba wamu tewali kizibu kisobola kubasinda. Ggwe muli mu kuteesa ki?
Tubadde tuteesa ku ngeri y'okuzzaamu muganda waffe amaanyi eyakosebwa obulwadde obw'omusujja.
Okulambula n'okumuyamba kumuzzaamu amanyi amangu nnyo! Katonda amuwe obulamu obulungi adde mu mirimu gye n'essanyu.
Wasuze otya nno omuntu wange eyalonda obumu obw'amazima?
Wasuze bulungi mukwano gwange! Obumu bwe bulyoza amaka n'ebika. Enkya yo eri ya ddembe?
Eri ya ddembe, mbadde nseka mwannyinaze eyabadde agezaako okwambala engatto za taata n'agwa mu luggya nseka!
Hahaha! Engatto z'abazadde ziba nnene nnyo ku baana bato! Muyambe ayambale ezize aleme kumenyeka akagere.
Mbadde njagala okukusiibula mu budde buno obw'okusanyukira mu ddembe, oli otya ssebo?
Ndi bulungi munnange! Nsanyuse nnyo okuba naawe mu by'omukwano n'ebisesa eby'olwaleero. Ggwe otegese kwebaka?
Yee mukwano, otulo tuzze. Sula bulungi era amaka go gabeere mu mirembe gyereere ekiro kino.
Kale sula bulungi nnyo mukwano gwange! Katonda akuwe otulo otuwoomu, tulisisinkana enkya n'essanyu eripya eritaliiko kkomo.
